sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 272249, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: Non-electric $22, electric $26 a night (2026 and 2027 peak seasons; the same in the first-come season). Campers who leave the campground to park at or use the Clark Lake beach/picnic area or the Clark Lake or Crooked Lake canoe launches pay a $5 daily vehicle fee or a $30 season pass.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/sylvania-clark-lake-campground ('Single Site with no electric hook-up: $22 per night', 'Single Site with electric hook-up: $26 per night'; last updated September 25, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/272249/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-30 and 2027-05-22 to 2027-09-15: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 22, STANDARD ELECTRIC 26) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/272249 (fee description: 'No daily fee is required unless you leave the campground and park, launch, or use facilities at the Clark Lake Beach and Picnic Area, Clark Lake Canoe Launch, or Crooked Lake Canoe Launch. Use of these locations requires a daily $5.00 per vehicle fee, or a season pass for $30 per vehicle.'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 272249 (10 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites, 9 bookable: Electricity Hookup 30 at 8, 20 at 2; no sewer attribute) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/272249 ('Some electrical sites available'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 48 drive-in sites in four loops for 'tents, trailers and motor homes' (one is a management/host site in the catalog); 10 electric. All back-in; catalog vehicle lengths 31-88 ft, most 40 ft or more. Eight people, two vehicles, and one RV or trailer plus two tents per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/sylvania-clark-lake-campground ('four camping loops with a total of 48 campsites and provides drive-in campsites that can accommodate tents, trailers and motor homes'; 'Eight people and two motorized vehicles are allowed per campsite with a maximum of one RV or camper trailer and two tents') + RIDB catalog (48 sites, Driveway Entry Back-In on all, Max Vehicle Length 31-88), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Water faucets in loops 2, 3 and 4; two flush toilet buildings and one accessible vault toilet; an RV water and dump station beside the campground. Day-use area with picnic area, swimming beach, canoe landings and trailheads adjacent.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/sylvania-clark-lake-campground ('Drinking water is provided by faucets in loops 2, 3 and 4, while two flush toilet facilities and one accessible vault toilet are evenly spaced throughout the campground'; Restrooms 'Flush and Vault') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/272249 ('Located adjacent to the campground is a water and sewage dump station for RV's'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Loop 1: May 15 - October 15; loops 2, 3 and 4: May 22 - October 9 (gate closed at noon CST October 9, 2026; water off from then). After October 15 loop 1 stays usable with no water or garbage service until snow reduces access or January 1, whichever comes first. Full services open the Friday before Memorial Day.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/sylvania-clark-lake-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Loop 1: May 15 – October 15', 'Loops 2, 3 and 4: May 22 – October 9', 'The campground gate on loop 2, 3 and 4 will close at 12 p.m. CST on October 9, 2026.', 'Reduced services on loop 1 begin October 15, 2026; no water or garbage services will be provided. Visitors can use the facility until snow conditions reduce access or January 1, whichever is sooner.'; 'scheduled to open with full services the Friday before Memorial Day'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 38 of 48 sites bookable on recreation.gov (cutoff 4 days before arrival); the rest are first-come, and 'typically there is always a site available'. Run by Camp Host, LLC under a special use permit; self-pay. A Sylvania permit (from the entrance station) is required of all day and overnight users. The site must be occupied the first night.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/272249 ('Some sites are reservable on Recreation.gov but other sites are on a first come, first serve basis and typically there is always a site available'; 'This campground is operated by Camp Host, LLC under a special use permit with the Ottawa National Forest'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 4, minimum-stay rules soft 0/1 = none) + RIDB catalog (38 reservable, 10 not) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/sylvania-clark-lake-campground ('All daytime and overnight users of the campground and wilderness must have a permit, which can be obtained from the Sylvania Entrance Station'; '24 hours – self pay'), read 2026-10-25

note: Drive-in Clark Lake Campground in the Sylvania Recreation Area, Ottawa NF, 7 mi SW of Watersmeet off CR 535 (distinct from the Sylvania Wilderness backcountry, which it adjoins). Paved access; sites screened by natural vegetation. Adjacent day-use swimming beach and canoe landings on Clark Lake. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated 2026-09-25) + rec.gov API/rates + RIDB: $22/$26 (confirmed, 2026-2027), 30-amp (confirmed; 8 x 30A, 2 x 20A), 48 sites (confirmed) back-in to 88 ft (new), flush + vault toilets, faucets, dump (confirmed/new), reservable on rec.gov with some first-come sites (confirmed; 38 bookable), 14-night max; season May 15 - Oct 15 (new; loops 2-4 May 22 - Oct 9). Concession-run by Camp Host, LLC; ownership federal kept. rec.gov minimums are soft 0/1 (no rule). Alerts: nothing names CR 535 or Sylvania. Note trimmed of field restatements.
